list.title: Bulk email
list.intro: Write one email to many people in the Help app: build it from blocks, choose who gets it, and send a test to yourself first.
list.empty: No emails yet. Start with New email.

editor.notFound: This email does not exist any more.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? It cannot be restored.
editor.unsaved: Your latest changes are not saved. Leave this email anyway?

save.invalid: Not saved: fix the marked fields.
save.changed: Another admin changed this email while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your last changes here were not saved.
save.notDraft: Sending of this email has started, so it can no longer be changed.

content.title: Content
content.name: Internal name
content.nameHint: Only admins see it, in the list of emails.
content.subject: Subject
content.preheaderHint: Mail apps show it next to the subject. Optional.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.empty: No blocks yet. Add a heading and some text to start.
blocks.limit: An email has at most {{max}} blocks.

fields.nameHint: Write {{placeholder}} to greet each person by name.
fields.textHint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. **bold** makes text bold, web addresses become links, {{placeholder}} becomes each person's name.
fields.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Use a PNG or JPEG file.
fields.altHint: Shown when the mail app does not load images.
fields.label: Button text
fields.urlHint: A web address starting with https://, or mailto: with an email address.
fields.dividerNote: A thin line between two parts of the email.

problems.invalidUrl: Enter a full address starting with https://.

notReady.no_blocks: Add at least one block before sending.
notReady.image_missing: This image is missing. Upload it again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.failed: The preview could not be loaded.
preview.note: Shown with your name, as you would get it. Blocks with problems are left out until they are fixed.

audience.title: Recipients
audience.rolesHint: Clients and requesters come from the chosen groups; admins are all admins.
audience.managersHint: Adds every group the ticked admin manages.
audience.groupsHint: With no group and no manager ticked, every group counts.
audience.leftOut: Left out: {{unsubscribed}} unsubscribed, {{disabled}} with a disabled account.

test.title: Test
test.intro: Send the email as it is saved now to your own address, {{email}}.
test.unsaved: Wait until your changes are saved.
test.unavailable: Test sending is not available on this server yet.
test.rateLimited: Too many tests in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
test.notReady: The email is not ready yet. Fix the marked problems first.

send.title: Send
send.intro: Send the email as it is saved to everyone in Recipients. You can stop the sending while it runs, but emails already sent cannot be taken back.
send.unsaved: Fix the marked fields first: only a saved email can be sent.
send.subject: Subject
send.notReady: The email is not ready yet. Fix the marked problems first.
send.emptyAudience: Nobody would get this email. Choose recipients first.
send.notDraft: Sending of this email has already started.

report.skippedHint: Unsubscribed or disabled before their turn.
report.unsubscribedHint: Through this email's link, still unsubscribed.
report.note: The Help app does not measure opens and clicks yet. 'Sent' means Elastic Email accepted the email, not that it reached the inbox.
report.readOnly: This email can no longer be changed. Duplicate it to send a new version.
report.cancelConfirm: Stop sending? People who have not got the email yet will not get it.

reason.unknown: Unknown result: the email may or may not have gone out.
